⚓ THE AUTHENTIC MARITIME BELL CLOCK — SHIP'S CLOCK

Hear the bells. Know the watch. Keep time the way sailors have for 500 years.

Ship's Clock rings the traditional ship's bell system every 30 minutes — exactly as practiced aboard ships since the 1500s. One bell at 12:30. Eight bells at 4:00, 8:00, and midnight. The complete maritime bell system, historically accurate, running in the background whether your screen is on or off.

This is not a clock app. This is a maritime instrument.

🔔 REAL SHIP'S BELLS — EVERY 30 MINUTES

Four authentic bell sounds:
- Classic Brass Ship's Bell — traditional bronze strike heard on vessels worldwide
- Iron Bell — heavier, deeper, old-world nautical character
- Harbor Call — the sound of working ports and tall ship docks
- Sonar Ping — submarine sonar pulse for the naval enthusiast

Eight bells marks the end of every watch. Bells pair and ring in sequence — exactly as aboard tall ships, naval vessels, coast guard cutters, and working boats worldwide.

🕐 FOUR STUNNING CLOCK FACES

- Admiralty Face — maritime dial, Admiralty blue hands, small seconds subdial
- Ship's Clock Classic — traditional Roman numeral nautical deck clock design
- Grand Central Terminal — legendary Tiffany opal clock with sweep second hand
- Cuckoo Clock — fully animated cuckoo with mechanical sound and video overlay

Every face runs against a living animated sky — sunrise, daylight, golden hour, sunset, and deep night rendered in real time from your GPS location. Stars appear at night. The moon rises and sets.

⌚ THE COMPLETE MARITIME WATCH SYSTEM

- Middle Watch · Morning Watch · Forenoon Watch
- Afternoon Watch · First Dog Watch · Last Dog Watch · First Watch

Watch name and bell count displayed live. Animated bell dots light up in pairs with every strike, mirroring the traditional pattern exactly.

🧠 TIME AWARENESS MODE — FOCUS AND ADHD

A single bell at :15 and :45 gives you four audio checkpoints every hour. Built for people with ADHD, deep focus workers, writers, developers, and students who lose track of time. Combined with standard bells at :00 and :30, you get a bell every 15 minutes. Stay anchored. Stay on task. Track your total time on watch and share your watch card to social media.

🌙 NIGHT SILENCE · DAILY ALARM · MECHANICAL TICKING

Night Silence — set quiet hours and all sound stops automatically. Resumes at your wake time.

Alarm — twelve sounds: Fog Horn, Ship's Horn, Steam Whistles, Conch She
